knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## R Markdown

This is the output for EPS704 Wk1, to include a CSV and Excel file.  The CSV file, Enroll had 800 observation, 25 columns (8 -char, 16-num and 1 date), while Excel file,Demo had 499 observations with 6 variables.

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
